public_sources.bound_semantics: Kazerouni et al. define a conservative performance constraint requiring cumulative expected reward at every round to remain at least (1-alpha) times cumulative baseline reward. CLUCB plays the optimistic action only if the constraint holds for the worst parameter in its confidence set; otherwise it plays the baseline.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: Use a fixed exact-reward baseline A=0.8 and bounded unknown B reward in [0,1]. Maintain durable accepted horizon t and accepted cumulative reward S_t. Before an uncertain B step t+1, require S_t >= 0.64*(t+1), which is a role-local deterministic worst-case lower-bound gate using B's known support lower bound0; otherwise play A.
chat_native_reduction.relation_to_source: This preserves the source control principle of allowing exploratory/optimistic action only when a conservative baseline-relative cumulative constraint survives a worst-case check. It does not reproduce CLUCB's linear confidence-set estimator.
chat_native_reduction.theorem_scope: The source's high-probability expected-reward guarantees and regret bounds are not claimed for this realized deterministic toy trace.
